metadata.summary: Jitin ordered a hot chocolate from Manhattan Bagel

messages.text: Hello Jitin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
I don't see hard copy on our menu. Let me share some options: HOT Coffee or Tea, Ice Coffee or Tea, or Cold Brew Iced Coffee. Would you like one of these or hear more options?
Our hot chocolate is a rich and delicious treat. Would you like to hear about the customization options for your hot chocolate, such as size or specialty milk?
For your hot chocolate, you can choose from two sizes: 16 ounces or 24 ounces. And for the milk, you can choose from our specialty milks. We have a few options: would you like to hear about them?
Hey. Hi. Hot chocolate has only three sizes, twelve, sixteen, and 20.
So you'd like a hot chocolate. For the size, we have 12 ounces, 16 ounces, or 24 ounces. Which one of these sizes sounds good to you?
Why you were saying sixteen twenty four ounce only?
I sometimes make mistakes. Our hot chocolate actually comes in 12 ounces, 16 ounces, and 24 ounces. I should have given you all the options from the start. So,
